frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_assertion: A frozen hypothesis names the invariant set, an Obzio reproduction tests it against our fault matrix, and the result either changes a live mechanism or is rejected with evidence.
frozen_hypothesis.falsified_if: the hypothesis remains a summary with no reproduction
frozen_hypothesis.hypothesis_text: Durable-execution workflow engines converge on a small invariant set (idempotency key, fence, checkpoint, outbox) that predicts which of our fault classes are survivable.

registration.prediction: A fault class is survivable by a durable-execution style custody engine iff the specific invariant it depends on is present: idempotency/dedup key for duplicate-effect faults, fence token for stale-writer-after-eviction faults, and an append-only history (outbox/event-log) for crash-and-replay faults. Removing the invariant a fault class depends on makes that class unsurvivable while leaving unrelated invariants intact does not fix it.

claims.claim: Durable workflow engines rebuild state by replaying a complete, ordered Event History; a Workflow must be deterministic given that history.
claims.evidence_snippet: Because the Workflow is re-executed to rebuild its state: It has to make the same decisions when given the same history, which makes a Workflow deterministic.

claims.claim: AWS Step Functions documents an explicit exactly-once vs at-least-once distinction tied directly to whether actions are idempotent.
claims.evidence_snippet: Standard Workflows follow an exactly-once model... Express Workflows use an at-least-once model... better suited for orchestrating idempotent actions.

claims.claim: A fencing token (a monotonically increasing number issued at lock/lease acquisition) is the standard fix for a paused/stale client committing after its lease expired.
claims.evidence_snippet: The fix for this problem is actually pretty simple: you need to include a fencing token with every write request to the storage service.

frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_assertion: A reproduction measures recovery rate under injected callback loss for both designs on the same workload and reports the difference.
frozen_hypothesis.hypothesis_text: Content-addressed result custody outperforms message-passing return for multi-agent fleets under callback loss.

registration.prediction: Under injected callback loss, a content-addressed custody design (result committed to durable, independently re-readable storage keyed by content hash) recovers a materially higher fraction of results than a message-passing design (result only reachable via a single in-flight callback).

claims.claim: Content-addressable storage keys data by the hash of its own content, so any party holding the key can independently re-fetch and verify the content, with no dependency on the writer's delivery channel.
claims.evidence_snippet: Git is a content-addressable filesystem... you can insert any kind of content into a Git repository, for which Git will hand you back a unique key you can use later to retrieve that content.

frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_artifact: reproduction-ledger.jsonl row plus classified defect table
frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_assertion: Defects found by cross-family reviewers are classified and compared against same-family findings on identical artifacts.
frozen_hypothesis.falsified_if: the comparison is not run on identical artifacts
frozen_hypothesis.hypothesis_text: Blind cross-family adversarial review catches a materially different defect class than same-family review.

registration.prediction: Two independently frozen review methodologies applied blind to the same seeded-defect corpus find a non-identical set of defect classes (neither is a subset of the other), so pooling both catches strictly more than either alone.

claims.claim: The founding conjecture of N-version programming is that independently produced implementations from the same spec fail differently, so diversity reduces correlated (identical) defects.
claims.evidence_snippet: the central conjecture that the "independence of programming efforts will greatly reduce the probability of identical software faults"

claims.claim: Real-world lightweight code review at scale is the deployed practice this hypothesis generalizes from; it does not itself measure cross-model-family diversity.
claims.evidence_snippet: we make an exploratory investigation of modern code review at Google

source.scope_limitation: This commission's cross-family review matrix means different frontier LLM families (e.g. reviewer po03-worker-a6 vs producer families). This subagent has no tool to invoke a second frontier model family live inside a dependency-free stdlib reproduction, and may not contact other PO-03 workers. The reproduction therefore operationalizes 'family' as two independently coded, methodologically distinct reviewers (static pattern-based vs dynamic property/mutation-based) as the nearest testable proxy for cross-family diversity, and this substitution is recorded explicitly rather than reported as literal multi-LLM evidence.

frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_assertion: A matched comparison on the same units measures acceptance and defect rate for capsule versus dump admission.
frozen_hypothesis.falsified_if: context admission is not actually varied between arms
frozen_hypothesis.hypothesis_text: Bounded hashed context capsules beat whole-tree context dumping on accepted-result rate at equal reasoning setting.

registration.prediction: At a fixed context budget, selecting content by relevance-ranked hashed chunks preserves a larger fraction of task-relevant facts than naive whole-tree dumping truncated at the same budget, and the gap widens as corpus size grows past the budget.

claims.claim: Language model performance on long-context tasks degrades when relevant information sits in the middle of a large, undifferentiated context, even for models built for long contexts.
claims.evidence_snippet: significantly degrades when models must access relevant information in the middle of long contexts, even for explicitly long-context models

source.scope_limitation: No live frontier-model call is available inside this dependency-free stdlib harness, so 'accepted-result rate at equal reasoning setting' cannot be measured directly here. The reproduction measures the necessary precondition -- fact-admission recall under a fixed token budget -- as a deterministic proxy, and the full acceptance-rate claim is recorded NOT_YET rather than asserted from the proxy alone.

frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_assertion: Escaped-defect counts are compared between preregistered and post-hoc criteria arms on comparable units.
frozen_hypothesis.hypothesis_text: Preregistered acceptance criteria reduce escaped defects relative to criteria written after seeing the result.

registration.prediction: Acceptance criteria frozen before an implementation is inspected catch a higher fraction of seeded defects across several implementations than criteria written after inspecting one implementation's happy-path behavior.

claims.claim: Preregistration means specifying a plan before doing the study, precisely so criteria cannot be reshaped by having already seen the outcome.
claims.evidence_snippet: the same data cannot be used to generate and test a hypothesis, which can happen unintentionally and reduce the credibility of your results

frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_artifact: runnable property harness plus reproduction row
frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_assertion: A dependency-free property harness is run against the control plane and the incremental defect count over the example suite is reported.
frozen_hypothesis.falsified_if: the harness duplicates existing example assertions
frozen_hypothesis.hypothesis_text: Property-based and metamorphic testing find custody defects that example-based tests miss.

registration.prediction: A hand-rolled, seeded property/metamorphic test harness run against the real validate_contracts.validate_result function kills at least one mutant of that function that the existing example-based test_validate_contracts.py suite does not kill.

claims.claim: Property-based testing checks a property over a whole input space rather than a handful of examples, exposing edge cases the author did not think to write down as an example.
claims.evidence_snippet: you write tests which should pass for all inputs in whatever range you describe... including edge cases you might not have thought about

source.scope_limitation: The Hypothesis package itself is a third-party dependency and is not installed in this dependency-free stdlib runtime, so the harness is a hand-rolled seeded generator/shrinker rather than an import of that library. It reproduces the property-based *technique* against the real validator, not the library.

frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_assertion: A seeded deterministic scheduler replays fleet histories and finds at least one interleaving-only defect or proves none exists within the explored space, with the seed and space size recorded.
frozen_hypothesis.falsified_if: the explored space is not quantified
frozen_hypothesis.hypothesis_text: Deterministic simulation testing of the whole fleet exposes interleavings that sequential fault injection cannot reach.

registration.prediction: A deterministic seeded scheduler that interleaves concurrent custody operations explores an explicitly larger, quantified space of orderings than the sequential fault-injection style already covered by the existing suite, and either finds an interleaving-only invariant violation within that space or proves none exists within it.

claims.claim: Deterministic simulation testing, pioneered by FoundationDB and since adopted widely, and dedicated interleaving-exploration techniques find concurrency bugs that ordinary sequential testing does not reach.
claims.evidence_snippet: Pioneered by FoundationDB, deterministic simulation approach to testing distributed systems gained more popularity in recent years.

frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_assertion: Recovery time and false-eviction rate are measured across at least four TTL values and an evidence-backed value is retained or the parameter is recorded as insensitive.
frozen_hypothesis.falsified_if: a TTL is chosen without measurement
frozen_hypothesis.hypothesis_text: Lease TTL tuning has a measurable optimum for this workload rather than being an arbitrary constant.

registration.prediction: Sweeping lease TTL across at least four values on a synthetic workload with a modeled task-duration distribution shows a non-monotonic trade-off between false-eviction rate (TTL too short) and mean recovery time (TTL too long), with an interior minimum of a combined cost.

claims.claim: Production lease services expose an explicit TTL/keepalive model in which too-short a TTL causes premature expiry and too-long a TTL delays detecting a dead holder.
claims.evidence_snippet: A lease expires if the etcd cluster does not receive a keepAlive within a given TTL period.

frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_assertion: The PO-02 causal defect list is coded against observed Wave A events and the relative contribution is reported with counts.
frozen_hypothesis.hypothesis_text: Producer self-certification is the dominant source of false completion, above tooling defects.

registration.prediction: Coding the documented Wave-A/PO-02 incidents in workstreams/po03/evidence/so02-operating-correction.json against the six causal_defects categories shows the self-report/self-certification-without-independent-verification category implicated more often than any single other category.

claims.claim: SRE postmortem practice treats an incident report as evidence about contributing causes, not as the producer's own certification of what happened -- the general pattern this hypothesis targets.
claims.evidence_snippet: it must focus on identifying the contributing causes of the incident without indicting any individual or team

claims.claim: Internal frozen evidence document recording the causal_defects taxonomy and the concrete PO-02/Wave-A incidents this unit codes against it.
claims.evidence_snippet: "worker self-report could represent completion", "provider return route was treated as result custody"

frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_assertion: The two designs are compared on recovery, auditability and collision count using the same Wave A history.
frozen_hypothesis.falsified_if: the mutable-file arm is not actually executed
frozen_hypothesis.hypothesis_text: An append-only event log with projections is a better state contract for this programme than mutable status files.

registration.prediction: Replaying the same real Wave-A ledger history through an append-only-log-plus-projection design and a mutable-status-file design, then injecting one lost/partial write, shows the log design detects the loss (hash-chain mismatch) and fully reconstructs history while the mutable-file design silently loses the update.

claims.claim: An immutable, ordered event history from which current state is projected is the durable-execution pattern this hypothesis compares against a mutable single-record file.

frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_artifact: computed conversion rate plus reproduction row
frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_assertion: Conversion rate is computed for registered versus unregistered hypotheses within this wave.
frozen_hypothesis.falsified_if: conversion is asserted without a denominator
frozen_hypothesis.hypothesis_text: Structured hypothesis registration before execution raises the research-to-mechanism conversion rate.

registration.prediction: Within this wave, hypotheses that were frozen in hypotheses.jsonl before their reproduction ran reach a decisive outcome (SUPPORTED or REJECTED with a measurement) at a higher rate than an ad hoc comparison group explored without pre-freezing criteria.

claims.claim: The mechanism preregistration protects against is criteria drifting to match whatever was already observed; the same mechanism should raise decisive-outcome rate for engineering hypotheses.
claims.evidence_snippet: Preregistering creates a specific plan for the upcoming study. Doing so helps to distinguish planned from unplanned work.

frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_artifact: live diff plus recurrence tests plus dispositions
frozen_hypothesis.acceptance_assertion: Two or more mechanism changes are made, independently recurrence-tested by a different owner, and each receives RETAIN, DELETE, SUPERSEDE, RETEST or REJECT with lineage.
frozen_hypothesis.falsified_if: fewer than two mechanism changes are independently tested
frozen_hypothesis.hypothesis_text: At least two admitted external methods survive independent recurrence testing after changing a live PO-03 mechanism.

registration.prediction: At least two of the mechanism changes proposed by units a5-u02, a5-u06, a5-u07, a5-u08 and a5-u10 survive a second, independent execution of their reproduction (fresh process, no shared in-memory state, and where applicable a different random seed) with the same qualitative outcome.

source.scope_limitation: The acceptance wording asks for recurrence testing 'by a different owner'. This subagent is confined to its own worktree/branch and has no tool to invoke po03-worker-a6 or po03-worker-a10 or to signal the coordinator to do so mid-unit. The recurrence test actually executed here is independent-process, independent-seed re-execution by this same worker; true different-owner replay is recorded as NOT_YET with that exact boundary.
